# netbox_mac_address (Data Source)

Retrieves a single mac address from NetBox. The lookup fails if no match or more than one match is found.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_mac_address" "example" {
  id = 1
}

output "mac_address_id" {
  value = data.netbox_mac_address.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `assigned_object_type` (String) The assigned object type of the mac address.
- `id` (Number) The numeric ID of the mac address.
- `mac_address` (String) The mac address of the mac address.
- `owner_id` (Number) The ID of the owner associated with the mac address.

### Read-Only

- `assigned_object` (String) The assigned object of the mac address.
- `assigned_object_id` (Number) The assigned object id of the mac address.
- `comments` (String) Free-form comments about the mac address.
- `created` (String) When the mac address was created.
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values of the mac address, as a map of field name to value.
- `description` (String) A description of the mac address.
- `is_primary` (Boolean) The is primary of the mac address.
- `last_updated` (String) When the mac address was last changed.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags assigned to the object, by name.
